title: Why 21 DTE May Change How You Manage Options
description:
Explore how capital allocation decisions may influence portfolio volatility in options trading. Analysis of short strangles and naked puts across multiple exit approaches — held to expiration, managed at 50% of max gain, or closed at 21 days to expiration — examines how timing affects day-to-day volatility swings. Discover why mechanical discipline around exit timing is a key concept for traders managing position size. tastylive digs into the data.
